mentions.name: Dog Breeding Program Manager
mentions.description: A niche web app that helps manage a dog breeding program, tracking the operations involved in breeding, with the goal of being useful to other dog breeders as well.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on (slowly) a very very niche web app to help my wife manage her dog breeding program. Maybe it'll be useful enough for other breeders to use it.
